description: Extend a previously generated video by its own model's extender (pass the task_id of the completed generation). Veo (default): requires prompt; aspect ratio is inherited. For a longer extension, try extending the extend-result's task_id again — chaining is not officially documented, so if it fails, regenerate at the target length instead. Grok: extends a Grok Imagine video — either preset mode (video_preset) or custom mode (prompt + extend_at + extend_duration). Extenders only work on their own model's generations.

base_model.description: Veo only: base model variant. Default 'fast'.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When set, the tool returns immediately with the task_id and UnificAlly POSTs the result to this URL when the task finishes. Webhook body: { task_id, status: 'completed'|'failed', data: { video_url | image_url | audio_url | ... }, error_message? } — note the media arrives under 'data', not 'output'. Use for long jobs instead of waiting.

confirm_cost.description: Only relevant if the operator enabled a spend guard. When a call exceeds the configured confirm threshold it returns a quote; retry with confirm_cost: true to proceed. Safe to ignore otherwise.

extend_at.description: Grok custom mode: seconds into the source video where the extension begins. Required with prompt.

extend_duration.description: Grok custom mode: extension length in seconds. Required with prompt.

model.description: Which extender, as an alias or full id: 'veo' / 'google/veo-3.1-extend' (default, adds 8s) or 'grok' / 'xai/grok-imagine-video-extend'. Each only continues its OWN model's generations: Grok extend needs a task_id from xai/grok-imagine-video — NOT from xai/grok-imagine-1.5-video, which cannot be extended. See list_models.

prompt.description: What should happen in the extended segment. Required for Veo, and for Grok custom mode (i.e. when video_preset is not set).

provider_options.description: Escape hatch for model-specific fields not exposed as named parameters (e.g. Kling multi_shots, Flux steps). Merged into the API 'input' payload. Rejected: fields the tool already manages (prompt, media URLs, task_id, ...) and reserved routing/billing/auth keys (model, callback_url, dry_run, api_key, authorization) — switch models with the 'model' parameter, not here. See https://docs.unifically.com for per-model fields.

task_id.description: task_id of the completed generation to extend. Extenders are model-internal: Veo extend works on Veo generations, Grok extend on Grok Imagine generations.

video_preset.description: Grok only: preset mode. When set, prompt/extend_at/extend_duration are ignored.

wait.description: Default true: wait for the job and return the finished result. Set false to get the task_id back immediately and poll with get_task — use for long jobs (high-quality video, full songs) or when the connection might time out.
